etymology: Phono-semantic: 才 (phonetic ザイ) + earth (土) — rooted in the ground at a place: to exist, to be located.
mnemonic: Planted here, verifiably — ザイ. 存在: existence with a street address; 現在: existing right now.

etymology: Compound ideograph: the net (罒) dropping on wrongdoing (非) — the wrong that gets caught: crime, guilt.
mnemonic: The net finds what the 非 did — つみ. 犯罪: caught and filed.

etymology: Phono-semantic: money (貝) + 才 (phonetic ザイ) — resources held as value: property, assets.
mnemonic: Raw potential converted to shells in the vault — ザイ. 財布: the vault you carry in a pocket.

etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic (杀) + 殳 'weapon-hand' — the blow delivered: to kill; figuratively, to deaden.
mnemonic: The weapon-hand finishing what it started — ころす. The polite jobs it also does: 相殺 cancels, 殺到 floods in.

etymology: Simplified from 雜: garments of many colors gathered like a flock of birds (隹) — mixed, motley: miscellaneous.
mnemonic: A junk drawer with feathers — ザツ. 雑誌: the printed junk drawer we all love; 複雑: the drawer you can't close.

etymology: Compound: two men (夫夫) presenting treasure (貝) — bringing gifts in support: to approve, to praise.
mnemonic: Both sponsors step up with the funding: motion carried — サン. 賛成: approval with receipts.

etymology: Pictograph: a hand gripping the record-keeper's tablet — the court archivist: history, chronicle.
mnemonic: The scribe's fist around the official tablet — シ. 歴史: what survived his edits.

etymology: Compound: troops (𠂤) under one banner — a full division; the one who commands mastery: teacher, master.
mnemonic: The banner everyone falls in behind — シ. 医師, 教師: masters of their divisions.

etymology: Compound: the heart (心) going forward (士, originally 之 'to go') — where the heart is headed: intention, ambition.
mnemonic: The heart with a destination stamped on it — こころざし. 意志: will, with the compass already set.

etymology: Pictograph: a hand (又) holding a cut branch (十) — a branch; what a branch does under weight: support.
mnemonic: Snap off a limb, prop the load with it — ささえる. 支店: the branch office; 支払い: support rendered in cash.

etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + 支 (phonetic シ) — the branch still on the tree: a bough.
mnemonic: 支 was the branch in your hand; put the 木 back and it's still growing — えだ.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 次 (phonetic シ) + money (貝) — wealth staged for the next move: capital, resources.
mnemonic: Money already earmarked for what comes next — シ. 資料 feeds meetings; 資本 feeds companies.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 以 (phonetic ジ) — one person taken for another: to resemble.
mnemonic: Squint and it's the same person — にる. 似ている: the double-take kanji.

etymology: Pictograph: the altar table with offerings — where heaven shows its signs; as a component (示/ネ) it marks everything sacred.
mnemonic: The altar displays; the sky replies — しめす. 指示 and 表示: the showing, secularized.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 戠 (phonetic シキ) — marking distinctions in words: to discriminate, to know.
mnemonic: Telling things apart precisely enough to name them — シキ. 知識: the label-maker of the mind; 常識: the labels everyone shares.

etymology: Compound: hand (扌) + 受 'receive' — the giving side of the handover: to impart, confer.
mnemonic: 受 receives; add the hand and you're the one giving — さずける. 授業: knowledge, handed across a desk.

etymology: Phono-semantic: a person under the rod with finishing strokes (彡) — polished by training: to cultivate, master, repair.
mnemonic: Sanded, corrected, sanded again — おさめる. 修理 repairs machines; 研修 repairs employees.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 行 'ways' + 朮 (phonetic ジュツ) — the practiced path through a craft: technique, art.
mnemonic: The route through the maze that only training finds — ジュツ. 手術: technique at its most unforgiving.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 朮 (phonetic ジュツ) — following the thread of an account aloud: to state, relate.
mnemonic: Walk the listener down the path step by step — のべる. 記述: the walk, written down.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 隼 (phonetic ジュン) — the water-level as the standard: level, standard; almost at level: semi-.
mnemonic: The spirit level's bubble — ジュン. 準備 brings things level before the start; 準決勝 is one level below the final.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 召 'summon' (phonetic ショウ) — the hand waving someone in: to beckon, invite.
mnemonic: The maneki-neko's exact gesture — まねく. 招待: the wave, engraved on cardstock.

etymology: Pictograph: an elephant — trunk at the top, massive body and legs below; borrowed for 'image, phenomenon' (few had seen one; all imagined it).
mnemonic: Trunk, bulk, legs: the animal everyone described and nobody had met — ゾウ. 印象: the elephant your mind keeps of things.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 尚 'esteem' (phonetic ショウ) + money (貝) — esteem paid out in treasure: a prize.
mnemonic: Applause with a check stapled to it — ショウ. ノーベル賞: the loudest staple.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 尚 (phonetic ジョウ) + cloth (巾) — the long banner always flying: constant, usual.
mnemonic: The flag that never comes down — つね. 非常口 is the door for when 'always' breaks.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 青 (phonetic ジョウ) — the heart's living color: emotion; the color things actually have: circumstances.
mnemonic: The heart showing its true blue — なさけ. 感情 is the palette; 情報 the world's colors, reported.

etymology: Simplified from 條: a slender branch — a long thin line; lines of a document: articles, clauses.
mnemonic: One twig = one line of the contract — ジョウ. 条件: the twigs your yes hangs on.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 爿 (phonetic ジョウ) + 犬 — originally the dog's form/appearance: shape, state; the document describing a state: a letter.
mnemonic: A snapshot of how things stand right now — ジョウ. 状態 is the picture; 賞状 the framed kind.

etymology: Phono-semantic: ear (耳) + 戠 (phonetic ショク) — the duties one is charged with (heard and obeyed): office, occupation.
mnemonic: The job description read into your ear on day one — ショク. 就職: the ear accepts; 職場: where it reports.

etymology: Compound: pruning a tree with the blade (刂) — cutting to shape: to regulate, control; the shape imposed: a system.
mnemonic: The hedge trimmed until it obeys — セイ. 制服 prunes the wardrobe; 制度 prunes society.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 埶 (phonetic セイ) + strength (力) — strength in full swing: momentum, force.
mnemonic: Not just muscle: muscle already moving — いきおい. 勢い: the part of force you can't fake.

etymology: Compound: heart (忄) + 生 'born' (phonetic セイ) — the heart as it was born: innate nature; one's born kind: sex, gender.
mnemonic: What the heart came installed with — セイ. 性格 is the factory settings; 女性・男性 the hardware line.

etymology: Compound: 正 'correct' (phonetic セイ) + 攵 'enforcing hand' — correcting with authority: governance.
mnemonic: Straightening society with a stick — セイ. 政治: the stick, debated on television.

etymology: Phono-semantic: rice (米) + 青 (phonetic セイ) — rice polished to its pure heart: refined; the concentrated essence: spirit, vigor.
mnemonic: Polish the grain down to its gleam — セイ. 精神: you, similarly polished.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 制 'cut to shape' (phonetic セイ) + garment (衣) — cloth cut and sewn: to manufacture; 'made in'.
mnemonic: Cut the pattern, sew the label — セイ. 日本製: the tag this kanji lives on.

etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + 兌 (phonetic ゼイ) — the share of the harvest handed over: tax.
mnemonic: So many sheaves per field, collected annually — ゼイ. 消費税: the sheaf taken at the register.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 責 (phonetic セキ) — thread spun as one's tallied output: accomplishments, results.
mnemonic: Your spool at day's end, measured — セキ. 成績: the spool with a grade on it.

etymology: Phono-semantic: a thorn over money (貝) — the debt that pricks: to press for payment, to blame; what presses on you: responsibility.
mnemonic: The unpaid bill with a spike through it — せめる. 責任: the spike you agree to hold.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 妾 (phonetic セツ) — brought into direct contact: to touch, join, receive visitors.
mnemonic: Two surfaces meeting without a gap — セツ. 直接: contact with nothing in between; 面接: contact across an interview table.

etymology: Compound: words (言) + 殳 'working hand' — ordering the work and setting it up: to establish, install.
mnemonic: Say where it goes, then build it there — もうける. 設計 is the saying; 建設 the hammering.

etymology: Compound: thread (糸) cut clean — the line broken: to sever, cease; cut off from all else: absolute.
mnemonic: Snip — and no thread continues — たえる. 絶対: cut off from every alternative.

etymology: Phono-semantic: altar (ネ) + 且 'stacked tablets' (phonetic ソ) — the ancestral tablets on the altar: forebears.
mnemonic: The shelf of name-tablets, oldest on top — ソ. 祖父, 祖母: the two nearest tablets, still warm.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + a phonetic (ソウ) — all strands gathered into one binding: total, overall.
mnemonic: Every thread pulled into a single knot at the top — ソウ. 総理大臣: the knot itself.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 象 'image' (phonetic ゾウ) — the likeness given body: a statue, an image.
mnemonic: The imagined elephant, finally carved — ゾウ. 想像 imagines it; 銅像 parks it in the square.

etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 曽 'layers' (phonetic ゾウ) — earth heaped layer on layer: to increase.
mnemonic: Another shovelful on the mound, daily — ふえる. 増える: the mound's autobiography.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 告 (phonetic ゾウ) — work advanced to completion: to construct, create.
mnemonic: Announce the project, then walk it into existence — つくる. 木造: made by this kanji, in wood.

etymology: Compound ideograph: laws engraved by blade (刂) on the bronze tripod (貝-form) — the inscribed standard: rule.
mnemonic: Cut into bronze so no one can argue — ソク. 規則: the tripod's descendants, laminated.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 則 (phonetic ソク) — sounding the depth by the standard line: to measure, fathom.
mnemonic: Drop the knotted rope till it touches bottom — はかる. 予測: measuring water that hasn't arrived yet.
